sights.address: Tempozan Ferry Landing, 3-2-25 Chikkō, Minato-ku ↔ 3-10-34 Sakurajima, Konohana-ku, Osaka (also Taishō-ku crossings e.g. Senbonmatsu, 1-11-1 Minami-Ongashima)
sights.w: Osaka City still runs free public ferries across its harbour rivers; the Tempozan crossing links Kaiyūkan's Minato-ku to Sakurajima (USJ side) — a genuinely local way between the bay sights, with more crossings in Taishō.

sights.n: Osaka Nanko Bird Sanctuary (大阪南港野鳥園)
sights.address: Nankō-kita, Suminoe-ku, Osaka (NW corner of Sakishima)
sights.w: Free tidal-flat wetland built on Sakishima as a stop-over for migratory shorebirds, with an observation building and tower; closed Wednesdays.

sights.address: Nankō-kita, Suminoe-ku, Osaka (Sakishima, by Trade Center-mae Stn)
sights.w: Big waterfront mall/trade complex on Sakishima beside the Cosmo Tower, with harbour-view boardwalks and the Osaka Bay sunset.

sights.address: Kaiyūkan West Pier, Tempozan Harbor Village, Kaigandori, Minato-ku, Osaka
sights.w: Sailing-ship replica of Columbus's Santa Maria run by Osaka Suijo Bus, looping Osaka Port from the pier beside Kaiyūkan (day and twilight cruises).
Indoor LEGO attraction (opened 2015) at Tempozan with a Miniland recreating Osaka in bricks, 4D cinema and DUPLO area — for ages 3–10; adults need a child except on adult nights.
